boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 浸水營國家步道（林業及自然保育署台東分署官方頁；枋寮水底寮至大武加羅板、越嶺點最低的古道；清代撫番道路史蹟）霧林步道主體（OSM 姑仔崙山登山口 trailhead 節點對位、待現場校準；海拔誠實留空）；清單主題的霧林季窗查無可繫結的權威季節資料源，誠實不建時間窗契約；與既有 tw-037 多良火車站（21.9km）題材錯位。
boosters_i18n.en: The Jinshuiying National Trail (officially listed by the Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency Taitung branch; the lowest central-range crossing, from Shuidiliao to Jia luoban, with Qing-era relics) - a mist-forest trail subject (OSM Guzilun trailhead node as proxy). No bindable mist-season source - honestly no time-window contract; disjoint from tw-037 Duoliang station 21.9 km away.
boosters_i18n.ja: 浸水營国家歩道（林業保育署台東分署公式、霧林と清代の史跡）（OSMの登山口ノードで対位）。季節窓は権威源がなく不構築。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 惡劣天候、能見度差、營運/季節窗外
penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
